name: Fab! Bourbon
ingredients_raw: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), SUGAR*, REFINED PALM OIL, COCOA SOLIDS (4.2%), INVERT SUGAR SYRUP, RAISING AGENTS (503(ii),500(i)), IODISED SALT AND EMULSIFIER OF VEGETABLE ORIGIN [SOY LECITHIN]. CONTAINS PERMITTED NATURAL COLOUR [150d] AND ADDED FLAVOURS (ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES CHOCOLATE, VANILLA). *INCLUDING 2% AS SPRINKLED SUGAR CONTAINS: WHEAT AND SOY
